title: The last open items behind the chat: what gets built on the build card, a short store status, the twin's switch on the DCLab panel, a runnable campaign route test, and a real-use pass on HyperAck
request: The owner's goal (the stop hook): every agentic system of R&D behind DCLab Code's chat, with Claude Code's and Codex's capabilities; the open items the last report listed.
spec: the agents plan's open items after step 6
plan: the campaign route test where it can run
the build approval shows what gets built
store status short enough for a chat
the twin's switch on the DCLab panel, the person's click only
a real-use pass on HyperAck, as an operations lead would ask

decisions.decision: The twin's switch is the person's click on DCLab Code's DCLab panel, never the agent's relay
decisions.why: it is the owner's switch and it spends; the app shows it beside DCLab's projects so the owner never leaves the app

decisions.decision: The store's runs stay the person's commands (! make store in the chat)
decisions.why: they write the store and take hours; the person already runs any command from the message box

change: R&D: orchestra/walk.py (builds summary), orchestra/service.py (the pause key in the view and resume), store/__main__.py (--brief), tests/test_campaign_route.py (new), tests/test_store_status_brief.py (new), tests. dclab-code: dclab_person.js (twin_switch, overview's twin), engine.js (a body that does not fit the pause refused; the pause key sent), config.js (PERSON_READS), web/app.js (the twin card), tests.

findings.defect: the campaign's route test never ran
findings.cause: it lived in test_agentic.py, which imports NOOA
findings.fix: the route tests live in tests/test_campaign_route.py, which needs only the product server: start on Claude, an unpriced model refused, a resume on another provider refused, a blocked provider alone

findings.defect: the build approval showed only the gates passed
findings.scenario: s_6bc07b2eac62: 'What it shows: state build, passed [...]'
findings.cause: the walk's approval summary held its state alone
findings.fix: the summary adds what gets built: the outcome, the prediction moment, the unit, what was said to leave out, the costs and the budget (each at most 400 characters; the draft keeps them whole), and the table's name, rows and columns

findings.defect: store status was too long for a chat
findings.scenario: the chat read 840 KB of store status (every workspace's name)
findings.cause: status prints every kind's workspace list
findings.fix: store status --brief: counts, sizes, how many workspaces, the last capture and totals (about 2.5 KB on the owner's store); the default unchanged

findings.defect: the twin's switch was reachable only on DCLab's Admin page
findings.scenario: the chat reached the twin but the owner had to leave DCLab Code to turn it on
findings.cause: the switch is the owner's: the agent's relay refuses it
findings.fix: the DCLab panel shows the switch and its caps; the person's click sends it through the person's channel from the app's own page, within DCLab's bounds; the agent still never can
findings.test: dclab-code server test (the panel reads it; the click sends it; bad values refused)

findings.defect: a team's card asked about a body DCLab then refused
findings.scenario: s_c3284725650f: the holdout approval sent as an answer
findings.cause: the card did not check the body against the pause
findings.fix: a body that does not fit the pause (an approval takes approve, a question an answer) is refused before asking

findings.defect: an approval could apply to a summary that went stale
findings.scenario: the card shows outcome churn; the understanding changes while it waits; Allow builds the new one
findings.cause: the relayed yes carried no key, so the walk took it for whatever pause was open
findings.fix: the view shows the pause's key, the card sends it (and says so), resume_value passes it on, and a stale key is asked again
findings.test: R&D test_orchestra_walk (a stale yes builds nothing); dclab-code server test

measurements.name: HyperAck through the chat
measurements.gate: leaks caught, the holdout read once, honest
measurements.result: time split (8,876 train, 2,219 held out); holdout ROC-AUC 0.664 (0.641 to 0.686); final fares kept out (training 0.61 to 0.92 with them); not ready, with reasons; $0.23

measurements.name: tests
measurements.result: dclab-code 105 of 105; R&D test_orchestra_walk, test_orchestra, test_orchestra_solution, test_chat_agents, test_campaign_route, test_store_status_brief

outcome: The open items from the last report are closed; the person approves what they can see, and an approval to a card that changed is asked again.
lessons: A card that shows what gets built must also bind the yes to that view: show it, then key it.
A test that no environment can run is no test: move it where its imports are.
risks: the Home agent's own build (home_build) card still says only that the five stages run
